prose.subject: URGENT: Vendor Payout Update - NEAR Account Change (INV-67926)
prose.body:
Hi Priya,

Hope you’re having a good week. 

I’m writing to flag a quick administrative change on our end. Our treasury team has consolidated our NEAR payouts to a new hot wallet to streamline processing times for our upcoming vendor settlements. This is part of our quarterly infrastructure upgrade.

Please ensure that invoice INV-67926, totaling 434.56 USDC, is directed to our new designated account: thornbruypayroll86.testnet

This change is effective immediately. To avoid any delays in processing or potential holds due to the old address being deactivated, could you please update your payment records and release the payment by end of day today? We are on a tight schedule to close our books for this period.

Let me know if you need any further verification or if you have questions. I can jump on a quick call if that’s easier.

Best regards,

Tomas Okafor
Senior Finance Manager
Thornbury Payroll
